lines.text: The LORD tells Moses to send one leader from each tribe to spy out Canaan, and Moses sends them from the Wilderness of Paran.
Moses tells the spies to go through the Negev and into the hill country and bring back some fruit.
At Hebron, where the descendants of Anak live, the spies cut down one cluster of grapes and carry it on a pole between two men.
After forty days the spies return to Moses at Kadesh and say the land is flowing with milk and honey.
Caleb quiets the people and says Israel can conquer the land, but the other spies say they seemed like locusts.
